provenance: Scripted by hand by Ignacio Rodriguez Caro to show a decoy concluded without action once the replayed clock moves. Not recorded from a model (ADR 16), and none of these turns measures model quality.

hypotheses.statement: Catalog's p95 for /products was high when the alert fired and is back to normal two minutes later, with nothing changed: a blip that recovered on its own, so no action.

unknowns: What caused the short slowdown; it ended before it could be observed in detail.
